ownerDecision.summary: The model's author (repository owner 20m61) chose to commit it as the default model with the embedded metadata unchanged, in a public repository, for commercial reception use.
ownerDecision.knownMismatch: Embedded VRM meta says OnlyAuthor / commercial Disallow / Redistribution_Prohibited, while this public repository redistributes the file and the product uses it commercially. Third parties must not treat the public file as licensed to them.
